sintoma: Chamado #5301 — Mesa 14 “caiu a rede”. LED da porta apagado após usuário ligar um switch de mesa barato.
cli_output:
SW1# show interfaces status err-disabled
Port      Name               Status       Reason
Gi1/0/14  MESA-14            err-disabled psecure-violation

SW1# show port-security interface GigabitEthernet1/0/14
Port Security              : Enabled
Port Status                : Secure-shutdown
Violation Mode             : Shutdown
Maximum MAC Addresses      : 1
Total MAC Addresses        : 1
Configured MAC Addresses   : 0
Sticky MAC Addresses       : 1
Last Source Address:Vlan   : 0011.2233.4455:20
Security Violation Count   : 1

SW1# show port-security address | include Gi1/0/14
Gi1/0/14  0011.2233.4455  SecureSticky  20

SW1# show run interface GigabitEthernet1/0/14
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/14
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 20
 switchport port-security
 switchport port-security maximum 1
 switchport port-security mac-address sticky
 switchport port-security violation shutdown
alternativas: DHCP snooping untrusted derrubou a porta para err-disabled
DAI trust faltando causa Secure-shutdown
Violation Mode Restrict com maximum 50 no output
Port-security violation shutdown (maximum 1 + sticky) — err-disabled psecure-violation após MAC extra do hub/switch de mesa
explicacao_profunda: status err-disabled psecure-violation; Secure-shutdown; maximum 1; sticky; violation shutdown. Segundo device no hub viola. Não é show de snooping/DAI. Remova o hub, limpe sticky se preciso, shut/no shut.

sintoma: Chamado #5302 — Softphone + PC na mesma porta via hub; maximum 2 com sticky. Após notebook de visita, violações sobem e o tráfego do visitante some (porta ainda up).
cli_output:
SW1# show port-security interface GigabitEthernet1/0/22
Port Security              : Enabled
Port Status                : Secure-up
Violation Mode             : Restrict
Maximum MAC Addresses      : 2
Total MAC Addresses        : 2
Sticky MAC Addresses       : 2
Last Source Address:Vlan   : aabb.ccdd.eeff:30
Security Violation Count   : 17

SW1# show port-security address | include Gi1/0/22
Gi1/0/22  000a.0b0c.0d0e  SecureSticky  30
Gi1/0/22  0001.0203.0405  SecureSticky  30

SW1# show run interface GigabitEthernet1/0/22
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/22
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 30
 switchport port-security
 switchport port-security maximum 2
 switchport port-security mac-address sticky
 switchport port-security violation restrict

SW1# show interfaces status | include Gi1/0/22
Gi1/0/22  MESA-22     connected    30         a-full a-100 10/100/1000BaseTX
alternativas: Porta err-disabled no status (contradiz connected)
Maximum 2 atingido com 2 sticky; violation restrict dropa MAC extra (visitante) sem derrubar a porta — count 17
Total MAC Addresses 0 no show
Violation Mode Shutdown no running
explicacao_profunda: Secure-up, connected, maximum=total=2 sticky, restrict, violation count 17. Terceiro MAC (visita) é dropado, porta up. Não é shutdown/err-disabled. Ajuste maximum ou remova sticky antigos se o design permitir softphone+PC+visita.

sintoma: Chamado #5303 — Após “ligar segurança DHCP”, PCs da VLAN 40 em APIPA. Servidor DHCP 10.99.0.10 no core.
cli_output:
SW1# show ip dhcp snooping
Switch DHCP snooping is enabled
DHCP snooping is configured on following VLANs:
40
DHCP snooping is operational on following VLANs:
40
DHCP snooping is configured on the following L3 Interfaces:
Insertion of option 82 is enabled

SW1# show run interface GigabitEthernet1/0/48
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/48
 description UPLINK-CORE
 switchport mode trunk
 ! sem ip dhcp snooping trust

SW1# show run interface GigabitEthernet1/0/10
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/10
 switchport access vlan 40
 switchport mode access
 ! untrusted (default)

SW1# show ip dhcp snooping binding
MacAddress          IpAddress        Lease(sec)  Type           VLAN  Interface
------------------  ---------------  ----------  -------------  ----  --------------------
! (vazio)

SW1# show ip dhcp snooping | include Trust
! none listed as trusted in operational summary (lab)

PC# ipconfig
   IPv4 Address. . . . . . . . . . . : 169.254.22.10
alternativas: Binding cheia prova leases ok
Uplink Gi1/0/48 trusted no running
Snooping VLAN 40 on, uplink sem trust, binding vazia, APIPA — offers do servidor dropados no path untrusted
Port-security err-disabled em todas as portas da VLAN 40 no output
explicacao_profunda: Snooping enabled na VLAN 40; uplink trunk sem trust; binding vazia; cliente em 169.254. Falta ip dhcp snooping trust no uplink (e caminho ao 10.99.0.10). Não há evidência de err-disabled em massa. Configure trust e reteste DORA.

sintoma: Chamado #5304 — “DHCP de testes” no armário (PC com ISC DHCP) na VLAN 20; produção sem lease. Snooping ligado.
cli_output:
SW1# show ip dhcp snooping
Switch DHCP snooping is enabled
DHCP snooping is configured on following VLANs:
20

SW1# show run interface GigabitEthernet1/0/7
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/7
 description ROGUE-LAB-PC
 switchport access vlan 20
 switchport mode access
 ! untrusted — sem ip dhcp snooping trust

SW1# show run interface GigabitEthernet1/0/48
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/48
 description UPLINK
 switchport mode trunk
 ip dhcp snooping trust

SW1# show ip dhcp snooping binding
MacAddress          IpAddress        Lease(sec)  Type           VLAN  Interface
0011.2233.4455      10.20.20.50      86400       dhcp-snooping  20    Gi1/0/11

SW1# show logging | include DHCP_SNOOPING
%DHCP_SNOOPING-5-DHCP_SNOOPING_UNTRUSTED_PORT: [shortened] drop offer on Gi1/0/7

! Servidor oficial no core (via Gi1/0/48 trusted) — leases ok em outras mesas
! PC rogue em Gi1/0/7 tenta oferecer 10.20.20.x
alternativas: Offers do servidor no access untrusted (Gi1/0/7) são dropados; binding mostra lease legítimo em outra porta
Uplink sem trust — contradiz ip dhcp snooping trust em Gi1/0/48
Snooping desabilitado no show ip dhcp snooping
Binding vazia globalmente no output
explicacao_profunda: Log UNTRUSTED_PORT drop offer em Gi1/0/7; access untrusted. Uplink trusted; binding com lease em Gi1/0/11. Snooping on. O “servidor” no access é tratado como rogue — comportamento correto do feature.

sintoma: Chamado #5305 — Host 10.30.30.88/24 estático (impressora) não comunica após “ativar ARP inspection”. PCs com DHCP ok.
cli_output:
SW1# show ip arp inspection vlan 30
Source Mac Validation      : Disabled
Destination Mac Validation : Disabled
IP Address Validation      : Disabled

Vlan     Configuration    Operation   ACL Match          Static ACL
----     -------------    ---------   ---------          ----------
30       Enabled          Active

SW1# show ip dhcp snooping binding | include 10.30.30.88
! (sem linha para 10.30.30.88)

SW1# show ip dhcp snooping binding | count
Number of bindings: 24

SW1# show ip arp inspection statistics vlan 30
Vlan      Forwarded        Dropped
----      ---------        -------
30        10220            188

SW1# show run interface GigabitEthernet1/0/33
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/33
 description PRINTER-STATIC
 switchport access vlan 30
 switchport mode access
 ! sem ip arp inspection trust

SW1# show run interface GigabitEthernet1/0/48
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/48
 ip dhcp snooping trust
 ip arp inspection trust

! Impressora: IP estático configurado na NIC; nunca usou DHCP
alternativas: DAI VLAN 30 off no show (Configuration Disabled)
Binding contém 10.30.30.88 explicitamente
Uplink sem arp inspection trust
DAI ativo na VLAN 30; impressora estática sem binding — ARP dropado na porta untrusted (drops 188); uplink trusted ok
explicacao_profunda: DAI Enabled/Active na 30; sem binding para .88; porta access untrusted; statistics com Dropped. Uplink com inspection trust. PCs DHCP têm binding (24 entries). Crie binding/ARP ACL estática ou redesign do IP da impressora via DHCP reservation.
